title: Observed storage trends for every basin
note: Slopes are seasonal Sen estimates in mm/year. q is seasonal Mann–Kendall FDR across basins; n is observed months. Full intervals and original p-values remain in CSR_basin_trends.csv. Basin names are listed in Appendix A.

title: TWSA climate reconstruction performance
note: Frozen ensemble, 2016–2023 test data. Target: naturalized WaterGAP, not GRACE. Errors are mm; anomaly NSE removes the training monthly climatology. Higher NSE and lower errors are better.

title: GWSA climate reconstruction performance
note: Frozen ensemble, 2016–2023 test data. Target: naturalized WaterGAP, not GRACE. Errors are mm; anomaly NSE removes the training monthly climatology. Higher NSE and lower errors are better.

title: TWSA additive trends and residual components
note: Calendar-month fixed-effect OLS slopes, mm/year, on common available months. O observed; C naturalized; H historical minus naturalized; R observed minus naturalized; E observed minus historical. R = H + E. These are not additive Sen slopes or measured pumping rates. Conditional intervals are supplied in attribution_wild_block_intervals.csv.

title: GWSA additive trends and residual components
note: Calendar-month fixed-effect OLS slopes, mm/year, on common available months. O observed; C naturalized; H historical minus naturalized; R observed minus naturalized; E observed minus historical. R = H + E. These are not additive Sen slopes or measured pumping rates. Conditional intervals are supplied in attribution_wild_block_intervals.csv.

title: GLDAS matched land storage performance
note: Soil, canopy and snow only; naturalized WaterGAP compared with GLDAS Noah on matched months. Errors are mm; bias = WaterGAP minus GLDAS. This does not validate full TWS, GWS or human-only storage.

title: Residual agreement with annual groundwater head
note: Longest-overlap retained-flags panel. Positive r means lower residual tends to occur with lower head. Detr r removes a linear trend. An em dash means unavailable evidence, not zero. Head is not converted into storage; no cross-unit NSE or RMSE is reported. Other station panels and conditional intervals remain in the complete CSV.

title: TWS residual agreement with independent reservoir storage
note: Scene-screened Level 1 estimates; fixed pre-2004 reservoir panel. Adjusted correlation removes season and trend. Intervals resample whole calendar years. Missing or insufficient evidence is left unavailable. This checks a surface-water component, not a human-only total.

title: Rainfall source sensitivity in the controlled Ridge model
note: Test-period anomaly NSE for the frozen Weather_memory Ridge experiment, holding PET and the native-forced parent target fixed. CHIRPS is unadjusted here. This is forcing sensitivity, not evidence that one rainfall product is more accurate. It is a different experiment from the ensemble in Tables C.2–C.3.

title: Basin mean forcing and supporting data 1
note: Available-month means within January 2003–December 2023. Rainfall and ET are mm/month; moisture is m³/m³; temperature is °C. Means are not annual totals. Coverage and sample counts differ between products and are supplied in forcing_summary_and_trends.csv. Actual ET, moisture and temperature are supporting context, not added climate-model predictors.
